Kerala CM Satheesan Denies Election Irregularity Allegations

Kerala Chief Minister Satheesan has rejected allegations of irregularities concerning the SIR (State Investment Review) and claims that it influenced the UDF's victory in Keralam. He stated that Keralam's case is different, implying a distinction from other situations where SIR might be involved.
